bpmFix.title: BPM Repair
bpmFix.intro: Analyze first, then repair. Beat This supplies the primary beats; librosa cross-checks independently. Rubber Band R3 preserves pitch.
bpmFix.confidenceHint: Confidence = 60% beat F1 agreement + 40% beat regularity (±70 ms matching window). This is neither a success probability nor an audio quality score. Drift measures the range of deviations from a fitted whole-track grid. Leave target empty to round the interpreted BPM to the nearest integer.
bpmFix.ambiguityHint: The detectors disagree by half, double or triple tempo. This song starts unchecked. Confirm the ½× / 1× / 2× beat interpretation.
bpmFix.allowLow: I have checked these beats and allow low-confidence repair (output must still pass verification).
bpmFix.copyHint: Creates a song in the current playlist using an available filename.
bpmFix.overwriteHint: Replaces the original after verification and updates playlist references if the format changes.
bpmFix.lossyHint: Lossy formats such as MP3 / AAC will be re-encoded.
bpmFix.invalidOptions: Check target BPM (30–300) and confirm each low-confidence song.
bpmFix.verified: Verified BPM {bpm} · BPM error {delta} · grid RMS {error} ms · off-grid beats {offgrid}
bpmFix.stretchWarning: {count} segments require substantial stretching. Listen to confirm audio quality.
bpmFix.peakAdjusted: Overall gain was reduced to avoid clipping.
bpmFix.busy: A BPM repair session already exists. Restore it from the task bar.
bpmFix.outputExists: An audio file already exists at the destination. This song was not published.
bpmFix.lowConfidence: Too few reliable beats or low confidence. Check the analysis.
bpmFix.verificationFailed: Output failed beat verification and was not published.
bpmFix.extremeStretch: Some segments require excessive stretching. Processing was stopped.
bpmFix.sourceChanged: The original changed during processing. Close and analyze again.
bpmFix.runtimeHint: Install the complete analysis runtime and Beat This model first.
bpmFix.librosaUnavailable: This analysis runtime lacks librosa. Update the analysis runtime and try again.
bpmFix.rendererUnavailable: Rubber Band R3 is unavailable. Repair or reinstall the app.
bpmFix.libraryBusy: Wait until the library merge finishes.
bpmFix.invalidPlaylist: The playlist or song location changed. Reopen the playlist and try again.
bpmFix.unsupportedFormat: Cannot retain this audio format. Choose WAV.
bpmFix.failedHint: Processing failed. Details were logged. Completed outputs are retained.
bpmFix.recoveryRequired: Another application occupied the original filename. The original audio is preserved in a recovery backup. See the log for its location.
